title: Du fragment de verre au réseau de l'océan Indien
purpose: Follow compositional evidence from a glass fragment through workshop and port to interregional supply networks, then return to what Manthai can actually claim.

zoom_excursion.local_payoff: Manthai is securely a working/redistribution node even when primary production at the port is not demonstrated.

content.takeaway: The technology question changes the causal role of the port: production centre and redistribution node are not interchangeable claims.
